Body.Content:
Enable employees to conveniently create, manage, and track HR-related cases through the Employee Self-Service (ESS) experience in Dynamics 365 Human Resources.

Employees can submit HR inquiries, report issues, and request assistance for scenarios related to leave and absence, benefits, and personnel management.

The capability provides a centralized experience for employees to raise HR cases, monitor their progress, and receive updates throughout the resolution process.

Key capabilities include:

Self-service case creation: Enable employees to submit HR-related inquiries and requests.

Case categorization: Organize cases based on the nature of the employee's request.

Case tracking: Allow employees to view the status and progress of their submitted cases.

Case notifications: Keep employees informed about case updates and resolution.

Integrated HR case management: Enable HR teams to investigate, manage, and resolve employee requests through structured case management workflows.

Business value

This capability empowers employees to independently manage HR inquiries while helping organizations streamline HR service delivery.

Organizations can:

Improve employee experience: Provide a convenient, centralized experience for submitting and tracking HR requests.

Increase HR operational efficiency: Reduce manual communication and administrative effort associated with employee inquiries.

Enhance transparency: Give employees greater visibility into the progress and resolution of their HR cases.

Streamline HR service delivery: Standardize case submission, tracking, and resolution processes.

Improve accountability: Enable structured case ownership and tracking across HR teams.

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: February CY2027
